entries.title: Jumping Flash!

emulation.emulator: PlayStation Classics emulator on PS4/PS5; DuckStation for owned original discs
emulation.notes: Use the PS4/PS5 classic for the official modern route, or DuckStation for owned discs if you need emulator configuration control.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation through the PlayStation Classics wrapper or a high-quality PS1 emulator.

primary.why: The PS4/PS5 PlayStation Store classic is the best current official route because it preserves the original PlayStation game on modern hardware after earlier PS3/PSP/Vita digital releases.
primary.how_to_play: Buy or access Jumping Flash! through the PlayStation Store/PlayStation Plus Premium classic catalog and play on PS5 or PS4.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically original, but the PS4/PS5 classic is the current official route on modern hardware.

all_releases.fidelity: Digital PlayStation classic for PS3 and PSP, later playable on Vita.
all_releases.reason: skip: older digital route, superseded for most players by the PS4/PS5 classic.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern PlayStation Store classic release of the original PlayStation game.
all_releases.reason: primary: current official PlayStation route on modern hardware.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced exclusive-content split across releases; the PS4/PS5 classic is preferred as the current official modern route.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a classic release of the PlayStation original, not a remake.

entries.title: Jumping Flash! 2

emulation.notes: Use DuckStation with an owned copy for modern display options while preserving the PS1 game.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation with optional emulator-side improvements.

primary.why: The original PlayStation release is the highest-fidelity sourced version of Jumping Flash! 2; the later PSN release is a digital reissue of the same PS1 game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original PlayStation disc on compatible hardware, or use DuckStation with an owned copy.

all_releases.reason: primary: original full release and the fidelity baseline for all later digital reissues.

all_releases.fidelity: Digital PlayStation classic release for PS3 and PSP.
all_releases.reason: skip: convenient reissue, but not a higher-fidelity or more complete version than the PS1 original.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced exclusive-content split; the PSN version is a digital reissue of the PlayStation game.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or remake was identified.

entries.title: Robbit Mon Dieu

emulation.notes: Use DuckStation with an owned Japanese copy for modern display options.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation with optional emulator-side improvements.

primary.why: Robbit Mon Dieu is a Japan-only PlayStation follow-up in the Jumping Flash line; the original PlayStation release is the complete sourced version, with the later Japanese PSN release serving as a digital reissue.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Japanese PlayStation release on compatible hardware, or use DuckStation with an owned import copy.

all_releases.reason: primary: original complete release and the source version for later digital availability.

all_releases.fidelity: Japanese PlayStation Store reissue of the PS1 game.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful digital route, but not a higher-fidelity or more complete version than the original PS1 release.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced exclusive-content split; the PSN version is a reissue of the Japan-only PlayStation release.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or English release was identified.

entries.title: Pocket MuuMuu

emulation.emulator: DuckStation with PocketStation support where available
emulation.notes: The PlayStation game can be played from an owned copy, but the intended experience includes PocketStation-linked content.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation and PocketStation presentation, limited by PocketStation feature support in the chosen setup.

primary.why: Pocket MuuMuu is a Japan-only Jumping Flash spin-off built around PlayStation play plus PocketStation-connected mini-game content; the original release is the complete sourced version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Japanese PlayStation release with a PocketStation for its intended companion features, or use compatible emulation with an owned copy where PocketStation support is available.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Japanese PlayStation spin-off with PocketStation-linked content.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release and the version containing the PocketStation companion features.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate sourced version was identified; the original PlayStation/PocketStation release is the complete version.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or English release was identified.
